title: Frontend Developer
description: Master modern web interfaces, responsive design architectures, component lifecycles, state management, and high-performance user experiences.

goal.objective: Engineer responsive, accessible, and high-performance client-side web applications that delight users and scale seamlessly across global devices.

learn.summary: Build a rigorous foundation in semantic HTML5, modern CSS layouts (Flexbox/Grid), JavaScript ES2024+, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and client-side performance engineering.
prerequisites: Understanding of how web browsers work

capstone_projects.title: Interactive Analytics Dashboard
capstone_projects.description: Build an enterprise SaaS dashboard featuring real-time charts, filterable data tables, dark/light theme persistence, and offline caching.

capstone_projects.title: Headless E-Commerce Experience
capstone_projects.description: Design an ultra-fast headless storefront with optimistic UI updates, cart synchronization, and lighthouse score of 98+.

interview_focus: JavaScript Event Loop, Closures & Prototypal Inheritance

topics.name: How the Internet & Web Works
topics.description: Deep dive into HTTP/HTTPS, DNS resolution, IP addresses, web servers, browsers, client-server architecture, and web protocols.

resources.title: How the Internet Works: A Deep Dive
How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes (Aaron)

topics.name: HTML5: Structure, Semantics & Accessibility
topics.description: Master semantic HTML5 elements, understand document structure, create accessible forms, embed multimedia, and implement ARIA attributes for screen readers.

resources.title: Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: CSS3: Styling & Core Concepts
topics.description: Understand CSS selectors, specificity, the box model, cascade, inheritance, CSS units (px, em, rem, vw, vh), and styling properties for text, colors, and backgrounds.

topics.name: CSS Layouts & Responsive Design
topics.description: Master Flexbox and CSS Grid for complex layouts. Implement responsive design using media queries, viewport units, and fluid images for optimal viewing across devices.

resources.title: A Complete Guide to CSS Grid (CSS-Tricks)
Introduction To Responsive Web Design - HTML & CSS Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)
Learn CSS Grid the easy way (Kevin Powell)

topics.name: Introduction to Browser Developer Tools
topics.description: Learn to use browser developer tools for inspecting elements, debugging CSS, monitoring network requests, and understanding console logs.

resources.title: Google Chrome Developer Tools Crash Course (Traversy Media)
Google Chrome Developer Tools Crash Course (Traversy Media)

project.title: Multi-Page Responsive Portfolio Website
project.description: Build a personal portfolio website with multiple pages (e.g., Home, About, Projects, Contact), fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports, using only HTML and CSS. Host it on GitHub Pages.

topics.name: JavaScript Fundamentals & ES6+
topics.description: Master variables (let, const), data types, operators, control flow (if/else, switch, loops), functions (declarations, expressions, arrow functions), scope, hoisting, and an introduction to ES6+ features like template literals, destructuring, and spread/rest operators.

resources.title: The Complete JavaScript Course 2024: From Zero to Expert! (Jonas Schmedtmann)
JavaScript Programming - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: DOM Manipulation & Event Handling
topics.description: Learn to select, create, modify, and remove DOM elements. Understand event listeners, event propagation (bubbling/capturing), event delegation, and common browser events to create interactive UIs.

resources.title: JavaScript DOM Crash Course - Part 1 (Traversy Media)
JavaScript DOM Crash Course - Part 1 (Traversy Media)

topics.name: Asynchronous JavaScript, JSON & APIs
topics.description: Understand asynchronous patterns like callbacks, Promises (chaining, `Promise.all`), and Async/Await. Learn to fetch data from RESTful APIs using the Fetch API, and work with JSON data formats.

resources.title: Asynchronous JavaScript and Event Loop (Akshay Saini)
The Async Await Episode I Promised (Fireship)

topics.name: JavaScript Modules & Classes
topics.description: Explore ES Modules (import/export syntax) for organizing code. Understand prototypal inheritance and ES6 classes for object-oriented programming in JavaScript.

resources.title: JavaScript OOP Crash Course (ES5 & ES6) (Traversy Media)

project.title: Interactive Weather & To-Do App
project.description: Build a single-page application that fetches real-time weather data using the OpenWeatherMap API and allows users to manage a to-do list, persisting data locally (e.g., using localStorage). Focus on dynamic DOM updates and asynchronous operations.

topics.name: Git & GitHub Fundamentals
topics.description: Learn essential Git commands (init, clone, add, commit, push, pull, status, log). Understand branching, merging, resolving conflicts, and collaborating using GitHub (forking, pull requests, issues).

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
How to create a pull request in 4 min | GitHub for Beginners (GitHub)

topics.name: npm/Yarn: Package Managers
topics.description: Understand the role of Node.js package managers. Learn to use npm/Yarn to initialize projects, install, update, and uninstall packages. Manage dependencies (package.json, package-lock.json/yarn.lock) and define scripts.

resources.title: What is npm? A Crash Course

project.title: Setup a Modern Frontend Project
project.description: Initialize a new project, set up Git, create a `.gitignore`, add essential development dependencies using npm/Yarn (e.g., a simple dev server), and push your work to a GitHub repository following a basic branching strategy.

topics.name: React Introduction, JSX & Components
topics.description: Understand the concept of a UI library, React's component-based architecture, the Virtual DOM, and JSX syntax. Learn to create functional components, props for data passing, and component composition.

resources.title: React Tutorial for Beginners (Programming with Mosh)

topics.name: State Management with Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext)
topics.description: Master `useState` for local component state, `useEffect` for side effects (data fetching, subscriptions, DOM manipulation) with proper cleanup. Introduce `useContext` for simpler global state management.

resources.title: A Complete Guide to React Hooks (freeCodeCamp)
React Hooks - Полный Курс (Про Все Хуки в 1 видео!) (Владилен Минин)

topics.name: React Routing & Form Handling
topics.description: Implement client-side routing using React Router DOM (BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, useNavigate, useParams). Handle forms with controlled components and basic client-side validation.

resources.title: Learn React Router v6 In 45 Minutes (Web Dev Simplified)
React JS Forms | Controlled Inputs | Learn ReactJS (Dave Gray)

topics.name: Styling in React Applications
topics.description: Explore various styling methods in React: CSS Modules, Styled Components, Emotion, and utility-first CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS. Understand their pros and cons.

resources.title: How To Style React Components: The Complete Guide
React CSS Showdown 2025: CSS Modules vs. Sass vs. Styled Components vs. Tailwind CSS (MaksDevInsights)

topics.name: Global State Management (Redux Toolkit)
topics.description: Learn about the need for global state management. Implement Redux Toolkit for complex applications: store setup, reducers, actions, and interacting with the store using `useSelector` and `useDispatch`.

resources.title: Learn React 18 with Redux Toolkit – Full Tutorial for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)
Learn React 18 with Redux Toolkit – Full Tutorial for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Advanced React: Performance & Custom Hooks
topics.description: Optimize React application performance using `React.memo`, `useCallback`, and `useMemo`. Learn to create reusable logic with custom hooks and implement error boundaries.

resources.title: How To Maximize Performance In Your React Apps (Web Dev Simplified)

project.title: Movie Database Explorer with Global State
project.description: Build a React application that integrates with The Movie Database (TMDB) API. Features include searching movies, viewing movie details, routing between pages, infinite scrolling for results, and global state management (e.g., with Redux Toolkit) for favorites or user preferences.

topics.name: Module Bundlers (Webpack/Vite) & Transpilers (Babel)
topics.description: Understand why module bundlers are crucial for modern frontend development. Learn the basics of Webpack or Vite for bundling assets, and Babel for transpiling modern JavaScript to older versions for browser compatibility.

resources.title: Webpack 5 Crash Course | Frontend Development Setup (Traversy Media)
Vite Crash Course | Faster Alternative To CRA (Traversy Media)

topics.name: Linting & Formatting (ESLint, Prettier)
topics.description: Set up ESLint for identifying and reporting on patterns in JavaScript code to maintain code quality. Integrate Prettier for automatic code formatting to ensure consistent style across a team.

resources.title: Configuring ESLint and Prettier for React
VSCode ESLint, Prettier & Airbnb Style Guide Setup (Traversy Media)
ESLint + Prettier + VS Code — The Perfect Setup (Wes Bos)

topics.name: Web Performance Optimization (Core Web Vitals)
topics.description: Learn techniques to improve web performance: image optimization, lazy loading, code splitting, asset compression. Understand and optimize for Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) to enhance user experience and SEO.

resources.title: Optimize for Core Web Vitals (Chrome for Developers)
Web Performance Ultimate Crash Course (Frontend Master)

topics.name: Deployment & Basic CI/CD
topics.description: Deploy frontend applications using platforms like Netlify, Vercel, or GitHub Pages. Understand basic Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for automated builds and deployments.

resources.title: how to deploy your react app in vercel (Anisul Islam)
Deploy React App To GitHub Pages Using GitHub Actions (Integrations Ninjas)

topics.name: Unit & Integration Testing (Jest, React Testing Library)
topics.description: Introduce testing methodologies for frontend applications. Learn to write unit tests for React components using Jest and simulate user interactions with React Testing Library.

resources.title: Testing In React Tutorial - Jest and React Testing Library (PedroTech)
Testing In React Tutorial - Jest and React Testing Library (PedroTech)

project.title: Production-Ready E-commerce Product Page
project.description: Refine a product listing/detail page, integrating performance optimizations (lazy loading images/components), ensuring accessibility, setting up linting/formatting, and implementing basic unit tests. Deploy the application to a cloud provider like Vercel or Netlify.

topics.name: TypeScript for Frontend Development
topics.description: Understand the benefits of static typing. Learn basic TypeScript syntax, types, interfaces, and how to integrate TypeScript into React projects for better code quality and maintainability.

topics.name: Next.js: Full-Stack React Framework
topics.description: Explore Next.js for building production-grade React applications. Learn about file-based routing, server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), and API routes.

resources.title: Next.js 14 Full Course - App Router & Server Components (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)
topics.description: Understand the core principles of PWAs. Learn to implement service workers for offline capabilities, web app manifest, and push notifications to deliver an app-like experience on the web.

resources.title: Progressive Web App Tutorial for Beginners (Step-by-Step Guide) (Udemy)
Progressive Web App Tutorial for Beginners (Step-by-Step Guide) (Udemy)

topics.name: UI Component Libraries & Design Systems
topics.description: Learn to leverage popular UI component libraries like Material-UI, Ant Design, or Chakra UI to accelerate development and ensure design consistency. Understand the concept of design systems.

resources.title: Material UI 5 (MUI) React Tutorial | MUI Responsive Real Project (Lama Dev)
Welcome to design systems - Lesson 1 : Introduction to design systems (Figma)

topics.name: Web Security Fundamentals
topics.description: Gain a basic understanding of common frontend security vulnerabilities such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), and CORS policies. Learn best practices for secure coding.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks
Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner
Learn CORS In 6 Minutes (Web Dev Simplified)

project.title: Full-stack Blog/E-commerce with Next.js & TypeScript
project.description: Develop a server-rendered or statically generated blog/e-commerce application using Next.js and TypeScript. Integrate a headless CMS (e.g., Strapi, Contentful) or a simple backend API. Focus on data fetching strategies, SEO, and type safety.
